findings.current: That made a hundred points in total. I had poured in a massive number of points—ones that would normally take ten Level-ups to earn—but I didn’t regret a single one.
findings.defect: The draft omits that he invested the entire hundred points all at once.
findings.rationale: 한 번에 explicitly specifies that the unusually large allocation was made in one shot.
findings.replacement: That made a hundred points in total. I had poured them all in at once—a massive number of points that would normally take ten Level-ups to earn—but I didn’t regret a single one.
findings.source: 합치면 자그마치 100포인트. 열 번의 레벨 업을 거쳐야 얻을 수 있는 막대한 포인트를 한 번에 쏟아부었지만 하나도 아깝지 않다.

findings.current: There had been countless crises, and someone had sacrificed themselves.
findings.defect: The draft turns the source’s deliberately broad reference to someone’s sacrifice into the more explicit claim that someone sacrificed themselves.
findings.rationale: 누군가의 희생 preserves ambiguity about the nature of the sacrifice; it does not explicitly state self-sacrifice.
findings.replacement: There had been countless crises, and someone had made a sacrifice.
findings.source: 수많은 위기가 있었고 누군가의 희생이 있었다.

findings.current: Thank goodness I had raised my muscles and Sinews and Meridians every time I leveled up. Otherwise, I would have been in serious trouble.
findings.defect: Rendering 근골 as only “muscles” omits the bones and bodily frame included in the term.
findings.rationale: 근골 refers to the bones and musculature or physical frame, so reducing it to muscles loses part of the physical reinforcement that let him withstand the attack.
findings.replacement: Thank goodness I had improved my bones and muscles as well as my Sinews and Meridians with every Level-up. Otherwise, I would have been in serious trouble.
findings.source: 레벨 업 하는 족족 근골과 근맥을 올려놔서 망정이지, 아니었다면 큰 낭패를 볼 뻔했다.

findings.current: But Cheongpung had martial arts. He possessed the Zaha Divine Technique, one of the greatest internal-energy cultivation techniques in the world, as well as protective qi.
findings.defect: The draft presents protective qi as a separate possession rather than identifying the Zaha Divine Technique itself as both an internal cultivation technique and a protective qi art.
findings.rationale: The construction 내공심법이자 호신기공 explicitly gives the Zaha Divine Technique both functions, which explains why it prevents the spear strike from harming him.
findings.replacement: But Cheongpung had martial arts—the Zaha Divine Technique, both one of the greatest internal-energy cultivation techniques under heaven and a protective qi art.
findings.source: 그러나 청풍에게는 무공이 있었다. 자하신공이라는, 천하에서 손꼽히는 내공심법이자 호신기공이.

findings.current: “He said it wasn’t martial arts, but empty space. Since it’s empty to begin with, you just accept it as it is and fill it in.”
findings.defect: The explanatory footnote for the Korean homophone wordplay is defined as footnote 4 but never referenced in the prose.
findings.rationale: The joke depends on two Korean terms pronounced mugong but written with different characters; attaching the existing note makes that otherwise invisible wordplay accessible and resolves the unused footnote.
findings.replacement: “He said it wasn’t martial arts, but empty space[^4]. Since it’s empty to begin with, you just accept it as it is and fill it in.”
findings.source: 무공(武功)이 아니라 무공(無空)이라고. 애초에 텅 비어 있으니 있는 그대로 받아들이고 채워 넣으면 된다고.

findings.current: - You have changed jobs to **Peak Master**!
findings.defect: “Changed jobs” is an unnatural rendering of the game-system class-change term 전직 and can be misread as ordinary employment.
findings.rationale: In a System notification, 전직 denotes changing or advancing character class, not changing employment.
findings.replacement: - Your class has changed to **Peak Master**!

summary: Six actionable findings: three meaningful fidelity/mechanical issues, two localized terminology or wording issues, and one unused footnote caused by a missing reference.
